items.text:
The exit load of 1% applies if the fund is redeemed within 1 year. Therefore, the exit load does not apply if the fund is held for more than 1 year.
[Source: HDFC Large Cap Fund - Direct Growth](https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-large-cap-fund-direct-growth)
Last updated from sources: 2026-09-27

items.question: What tax rate applies if I redeem HDFC Large Cap Fund within one year?
items.text:
If you redeem HDFC Large Cap Fund - Direct Growth within one year, returns are taxed at 20%.
[Source: HDFC Large Cap Fund - Direct Growth](https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-large-cap-fund-direct-growth)
Last updated from sources: 2026-09-27

items.question: What tax rate applies to HDFC Large Cap Fund after one year?
items.text:
If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.
[Source: HDFC Large Cap Fund - Direct Growth](https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-large-cap-fund-direct-growth)
Last updated from sources: 2026-09-27
